Corollary
[Schauder fixed point theorem for compact maps] Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0292 1. ch11:11.2\group gt-ch11

Let $\G $ be closed and convex in a Banach space. If $T:\G \to \G $ is continuous and $T(\G )$ is precompact, then $T$ has a fixed point.
Proof

\sketch Apply Theorem 1 to the closed convex hull of $T(\G )$, which is a compact subset of $\G $ invariant under $T$.

□
